title: Vid-Group: Temporal Video Grounding Pretraining from Unlabeled Videos in the Wild

problems.name: Annotation Scarcity and Noisy Supervision
problems.evidence_sentence: Unlike existing works that directly train models on manually curated data, we propose a novel paradigm to reduce annotation costs: pretraining the model on unlabeled, real-world videos.

problems.name: Dataset, Benchmark, and Evaluation Mismatch
problems.evidence_sentence: Unlike existing works that directly train models on manually curated data, we propose a novel paradigm to reduce annotation costs: pretraining the model on unlabeled, real-world videos.

problems.name: Long-Video Evidence Sparsity and Efficient Selection
problems.evidence_sentence: In the following memory-consensus correction phase, a memory bank tracks the model predictions, progressively correcting the temporal boundaries based on consensus within the memory.

methods.name: Pretraining, Pseudo-Labeling, and Data Generation
methods.evidence_sentence: To support this, we introduce Temporal Video Grounding Pretraining (Vid-Group), a large-scale dataset collected in a scalable manner with minimal human intervention, consisting of over 50K videos captured in the wild and 200K pseudo annotations.

methods.name: Weak-Supervision and Pseudo-Label Correction
methods.evidence_sentence: The semantics-guided refinement enhances the pseudo labels by leveraging semantic similarity with video frames to clean out unpaired data and make initial adjustments to temporal boundaries.
